files.patch:
@@ -19,6 +19,16 @@ jobs:
         with:
           node-version: "24"
 
+      - name: Cache Spago packages and output
+        uses: actions/cache@v4
+        with:
+          path: |
+            .spago
+            output
+          key: spago-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('spago.yaml', 'spago.lock') }}
+          restore-keys: |
+            spago-${{ runner.os }}-
+
       - name: Install the PureScript toolchain
         run: npm i -g purescript@0.15.16 spago@1.0.4

@@ -4,7 +4,8 @@
 # `Grammark.Codegen.Main` import node-fs/node-buffer, so the parser/IR import
 # cleanly into a browser/worker (incremental-spec §9, ADR D13).
 # Build locally with:  npm i -g purescript spago  &&  spago build
-# (The packageSet registry version may need bumping to a current release.)
+# Package-set registry 66.0.0 is pinned and resolves clean under
+# --pedantic-packages; CI caches .spago + output across runs.
 package:
   name: grammark
   publish:
